notes: No theme in this batch is separate: every sub-theme of countries lists countries and every sub-theme of cities lists cities, so all read correctly under their parent. Nothing was removed (no fiction). Accents follow Wikipedia/Britannica-style English spellings (São Paulo, Zürich, Kraków, Málaga, Ürümqi, Malé); English exonyms stay plain (Munich, Cologne, Seville, Montreal, Istanbul). Turkish cities now use Turkish letters including dotless ı and dotted İ (İzmir, Şanlıurfa, Diyarbakır, Elazığ): check that the plain-letter derivation maps ı->i and İ->I. Romanian uses comma-below ș (Chișinău, Timișoara, Brașov). Vietnamese and most Japanese names kept plain as usual in English (Hue, Hoi An, Kobe); Ōita and Ōtsu took macrons as Wikipedia does. Sanaa kept without apostrophe (usual English form). San Jose is San José only in capital cities (Costa Rica); the California one stays plain in american cities. Usual short forms kept over long ones (Rio, Bosnia, Trinidad, Ivory Coast, UAE plus the added United Arab Emirates).
